11028|aa37b039.name: Jemma Quikswitch
11028|aa37b039.text: Well... I hate to admit it, but my sister's the one you'll have to talk to if you want to continue training. I don't know as much as she does... yet! She's standing over by the rocket car.

1154|3696a22b.name: Marek Ironheart
1154|3696a22b.text:
Though I hate to admit it, the bear did get the better of me. My oh my, that's one big ol' bear!

Nonetheless, if you can take that bear down, it'd be a feat to be proud of! It gave more than a few of our best hunters some trouble.

<He claps you on the back.>

Best the bear and we'll accept you as a regular member of the Farstrider Lodge.

1154|b7c42d9a.name: Marek Ironheart
1154|b7c42d9a.text:
Here at the Farstrider lodge, we prize hunting skills above all else. Wish to gain my approval? You'll have to earn it.

You look up to the challenge, lad!

1286|fe52f4ea.name: Edna Mullby
1286|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1289|ed056522.name: Gunther Weller
1289|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

2057|f6158e52.name: Huldar
2057|f6158e52.text:
Delivering these barrels to the excavation site is hard work, but there are so many depending on us to get the blast powder there.

We must do what we can against the Dark Irons!

2457|105cd232.name: John Burnside
2457|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

5174|3c00750a.name: Springspindle Fizzlegear
5174|3c00750a.text: The things I would teach you would turn your brain to jelly! Come back when you've learned sufficiently!

5483|877c4b1d.name: Erika Tate
5483|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

5595|632a21ad.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|632a21ad.text: Well well!  You've come to the right place to learn Mining, boyo!  Geofram Bouldertoe himself resides at the Deepmountain Mining Guild.  Ye couldn't ask for a better instructor than him.

5595|8f560eff.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|8f560eff.text: Which profession trainer would ye be looking for?

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

9099|c91575ec.name: Sraaz
9099|c91575ec.text: Nana always said there was no greater thing in the whole world than a warm, toasty slice of fresh, homemeade cherry pie.

1338-progress.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-progress.text:
A letter from the dwarven lands?  I wonder who would call from so far to the north...

Please, let me see the order.
1338-progress.title: Stormpike's Order

2038-accept.name: Bingles Blastenheimer
2038-accept.text:
As if crashing into the Loch wasn't bad enough, troggs from the nearby island attacked me and stole my tools and special Blastenheimer Blastencapper explosives. With no gyrocopter and no explosives, the movement has no chance!

Get my tools back and find my Blastencapper explosives, $N. For Gnomeregan!
2038-accept.title: Bingles' Missing Supplies

2038-complete.name: Bingles Blastenheimer
2038-complete.text: You've done the movement a great service, $N. The troggs and leper gnomes infesting Gnomeregan will soon feel the brunt of a gnomish air assault!
2038-complete.title: Bingles' Missing Supplies

2039-accept.name: Gnoarn
2039-accept.text:
We've lost contact with Bingles! He was sent on a reconnaissance mission over Gnomeregan and hasn't reported back in over a week. I just know he's gone and blown himself up.

He was last seen flying over the Loch. Perhaps you can investigate, $N.
2039-accept.title: Find Bingles

2039-complete.name: Bingles Blastenheimer
2039-complete.text:
So Gnoarn doesn't trust my reconnaissance abilities? I wonder why...

Nevermind that, I need your assistance! Nay! The movement needs your assistance!
2039-complete.title: Find Bingles

2041-accept.name: Gnoarn
2041-accept.text:
Perhaps... Perhaps you can help us in the battle for Gnomeregan.

In Stormwind you will find the commander of our underground assault crew, Shoni the Shilent. Shoni needs assistance with her gyrodrillmatic excavationators.

You will probably find her amongst the dwarves in Stormwind.

Good luck, $N.
2041-accept.title: Speak with Shoni

2041-complete.name: Shoni the Shilent
2041-complete.text: Do you bring word from central command?
2041-complete.title: Speak with Shoni

217-accept.name: Captain Rugelfuss
217-accept.text:
$N, our scouts have identified the leader of this recent Trogg incursion.  It appears that these beasts in Loch Modan are following the lead of a chieftain named Grawmug.  Grawmug is heavily guarded, however.  Two of his most elite guards, Gnasher and Brawler, never leave his side.

If you feel yourself worthy, $N, I want you to lead the assassination mission on Grawmug and his two thugs.  With the Trogg leadership dead, we just might stand a chance at pushing these beasts back into the ground.
217-accept.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

217-complete.name: Captain Rugelfuss
217-complete.text: Most excellent, $N!  You have brought hope to Loch Modan.  With Grawmug dead, we stand a better chance of seeing the Troggs eliminated from the land.
217-complete.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

237-complete.name: Mountaineer Gravelgaw
237-complete.text:
You accomplished your mission well, $r.  The King himself would be proud.

The reinforcements promised to us never showed, however.  Apparently the Alliance front is a sea of crimson from the blood of our fallen brethren.  The news of the losses leaves a bitter taste in one's mouth.  But we must not let their deaths go for naught.  We must rally in these grim times and bring glory back to the Alliance.

Speak with Mountaineer Wallbang for reassignment.  You're needed now more than ever.
237-complete.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

255-accept.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
255-accept.text:
Two months just to hear from Ironforge that we'll be spared a handful of soldiers for our own defense, and another two months until they arrive! Bad enough that our town goes unprotected, but the excavation and the dam--the dam!--are open to attacks as well.

I've no choice then, it seems. I'll need hired arms.

How about you? You seem a likely sort, $c. A group of ogres has set up camp on the northeast of the lake. Perhaps you could recruit some others and help remove the threat to our town?
255-accept.title: Mercenaries

257-accept.name: Daryl the Youngling
257-accept.text:
Think you can match wits with Daryl the Bold, huh? I should think not! Of course, you're more than welcome to try. Here's a challenge that should prove to be above your abilities, so don't feel too bad if you can't face up to it.

A flock of buzzards has nested here in Loch Modan. Why don't you try to take down some of the beasts? Tell you what, if you meet my challenge in fifteen minutes, I'll give you my bow or gun.

<He looks you over dismissively.>

It seems you haven't much to lose, anyways.
257-accept.title: A Hunter's Boast

257-complete.name: Daryl the Youngling
257-complete.text:
What? Success?

Take it from me, Murinama, you don't let it get to your head. I mean, any unshaven boy with a bow could have killed such... small specimens. And I hope you don't enjoy killing the buzzards so much, yes? We wouldn't want them to become extinct. 

Well, err... Never let it be said that Daryl the Bold would not hold to his word.
257-complete.title: A Hunter's Boast

258-accept.name: Daryl the Youngling
258-accept.text:
Murinath, is it? I can tell you're bursting with pride over completing the first test, hm? As I told you before, it's no large feat.

You should try your hand at boar hunting. Trust me, this is no Coldridge Valley boar hunt, so you'd best have a care with them. I'll give you just twelve minutes this time.

Don't feel bad if you fail. I'd give you the shirt off my back if you succeeded!

Have I ever related to you the story of how I received my famous scar? No? It was two years ago...
258-accept.title: A Hunter's Challenge

258-complete.name: Daryl the Youngling
258-complete.text:
You seem a bit worse for wear. No doubt the boars gave you some trouble, hm? No worries, I will be discreet about your struggle, I can imagine how hard it must be for you without the accusations of wagging tongues.

Oh! You managed to kill the boars? I... well, that is... that is to say, I'm not surprised! Any child could have--bet?

What bet?
258-complete.title: A Hunter's Challenge

263-accept.name: Mountaineer Wallbang
263-accept.text:
The Mountaineers tell me you are quite brave and capable, $N.  We need a $r like you around here.  The Trogg problem isn't getting any better.  The reserves have been called to the front and we're all alone out here.  But now that we have a seasoned $c here, let's see what you can do.

Go out and kill 10 Stonesplinter $C and 10 Stonesplinter Bonesnappers.  Let's see if you live up to your reputation, Trogg-Slayer.
263-accept.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

263-complete.name: Mountaineer Wallbang
263-complete.text:
I knew the second I laid eyes on you, $N, that you would make Ironforge proud.  You have served King Magni well.  Now that you've proven yourself to be such a loyal aid to the Kingdom, perhaps you should talk with the Captain to see if he'll entrust you with a higher detail.

I salute you, $N.
263-complete.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

267-progress.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-progress.text: Do you have 8 Trogg Stone Teeth to show me?  If not, there is still work to be done, $N.
267-progress.title: The Trogg Threat

271-accept.name: Vyrin Swiftwind
271-accept.text:
I don't suppose you'd be interested in a little payback for His Boldness? Daryl does have some skill, it pains me to say.

A year ago, a large bear had been the target of the Farstrider Lodge, but none of the hunters had any luck with him. So, Daryl thought he'd try his hand against him. All he had to show for his effort was that ugly scar over his eye.

Kill the bear, and I'm sure even Daryl would be speechless for once.

The bear, Ol' Sooty, can be found around his lair in the hills over Thelsamar.
271-accept.title: Vyrin's Revenge

291-complete.name: Senator Barin Redstone
291-complete.text:
<He quickly peruses the report.>

Authority of the KING!? Has Magni taken complete leave of his senses! And that damnable Whitebeard... Taken matters into his own hands, has he? The Senate will not be pleased to hear about this, not one bit.

What, are you still here? Go, before I call the guards!
291-complete.title: The Reports

291-progress.name: Senator Barin Redstone
291-progress.text: Hmm... it would seem that my guards are becoming less discriminatory with petitioners. Well, what do you want? Make it quick.
291-progress.title: The Reports

297-accept.name: Magmar Fellhew
297-accept.text:
Recently, just before the Troggs surfaced within the site, we had uncovered a large number of strange, carved idols.  But we didn't have the chance to study them, for soon after their discovery the Troggs chased us away from the ruins!  And those idols have a strange effect on the Troggs.  It makes them go berserk!

Bring me 8 idols - I want to study them, and I want them out of Trogg hands!  You can find the idols on the Troggs infesting the site.
297-accept.title: Gathering Idols

298-accept.name: Prospector Ironband
298-accept.text:
I need a progress report sent to Thelsamar - a progress report, and a restatement of my request for more blastpowder!  Here's the report.  Take it to Jern Hornhelm.  He's our local contact in Thelsamar.

It's not a difficult task, but it must be done.
298-accept.title: Excavation Progress Report

298-complete.name: Jern Hornhelm
298-complete.text:
Bah!  Ironband's having trouble with the Troggs.  I wonder if he wants that blastpowder to aid his digging, or to aid his efforts against the Trogg beasts...

Well, either way it's powder well spent!

But what's strange is, I sent him plenty of blastpowder weeks ago.  I wonder where it went...
298-complete.title: Excavation Progress Report

298-progress.name: Jern Hornhelm
298-progress.text: Oh, a progress report from the site?  Very good!
298-progress.title: Excavation Progress Report

301-accept.name: Jern Hornhelm
301-accept.text:
We'll need approval to get Ironband more blastpowder. You'll have to take his report to the Explorers' League headquarters in Ironforge.

Here's the report. Give it to Prospector Stormpike, and don't forget to duck after you deliver it. Stormpike is hotheaded, and he won't be happy to hear of Ironband's slow progress at the site.

You'll find Stormpike in the Assembly of Explorers.
301-accept.title: Report to Ironforge

301-complete.name: Prospector Stormpike
301-complete.text:
Curse that Ironband!  I sent him a load of blastpowder weeks ago, but he's made no mention of it in this report.

So...where did the blastpowder go?!?
301-complete.title: Report to Ironforge

301-progress.name: Prospector Stormpike
301-progress.text: We Stormpikes don't like being bothered with trivial matters, $c.  I hope you brought news worthy of my valuable attention.
301-progress.title: Report to Ironforge

302-accept.name: Prospector Stormpike
302-accept.text:
If Ironband still needs blastpowder, then by Magni he'll have it!  I sent the approval on ahead with a messenger to Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar.  He'll prepare the powder and other supplies to take to Ironband.

And one more thing: I want you to personally see that the shipment of powder reaches its destination.  The last one didn't, so keep your mind sharp and your eyes open.
302-accept.title: Powder to Ironband

307-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-progress.text: Do you have that Miners' Gear, $N?
307-progress.title: Filthy Paws

314-progress.name: Rudra Amberstill
314-progress.text: Vagash still terrorizes the herd!  Please help us by killing the wretched beast.
314-progress.title: Protecting the Herd

315-progress.name: Rejold Barleybrew
315-progress.text: Do you have that shimmerweed?  I almost have a batch of stout ready to brew, and I want to try throwing the weed in with this mixture.
315-progress.title: The Perfect Stout

319-complete.name: Rejold Barleybrew
319-complete.text: Thank you, $N.  It'll be nice to work our crafts without hearing so many growls and snorts outside the village.
319-complete.title: A Favor for Evershine

320-accept.name: Rejold Barleybrew
320-accept.text: Here's your cask of Evershine, $N.  And again, thank you for the hunting earlier.
320-accept.title: Return to Bellowfiz

320-complete.name: Pilot Bellowfiz
320-complete.text: Yes, this will do just fine.  I think I'll open a bottle right now and have a taste...
320-complete.title: Return to Bellowfiz

385-accept.name: Marek Ironheart
385-accept.text:
Many a hunter is attracted to Loch Modan to hunt our famous crocs. There are always merchants who seek out crocolisk skins for clothing items or armor, and there are also some who enjoy the taste of their meat.

We do some trade in this, but not a huge amount, as the crocolisks are ferocious and have entrenched themselves on the islands in the Loch. But don't let me dissuade you, it's quite an experience, wrestling with the jaws of the beasts.

Why, this one time...
385-accept.title: Crocolisk Hunting

385-complete.name: Marek Ironheart
385-complete.text: Well now, these are excellent specimens you collected, $N. Good money for high quality materials, that's for sure.
385-complete.title: Crocolisk Hunting

385-progress.name: Marek Ironheart
385-progress.text: Did I tell you about the time I almost lost my hand to one of the crocs? Nasty bugger it was, teeth like knives. But I was lucky... Jammed the brute's jaw shut with my knife. Still have the knife around here somewhere...
385-progress.title: Crocolisk Hunting

399-accept.name: Baros Alexston
399-accept.text:
It seems an eternity since I was a boy working the farm in Westfall. They say you can never go back, and it's true. Doubly true in my case, my family's home has been burned down and taken over by thieves.

I have spoken with my father about the fate of some of my possessions, including my first compass. He was unable to save them. However, he also says that they should be hidden away on the farm.

You'll find the Alexston Farmstead west of Sentinel Hill. Perhaps you could go and retrieve it for me?
399-accept.title: Humble Beginnings

413-progress.name: Mountaineer Barleybrew
413-progress.text:
Hello, $C!  And what business takes you all the way out here?

Something exciting, I hope.  I haven't been in a good fight in days, and this barrel of ale is almost dry...
413-progress.title: Shimmer Stout

416-progress.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
416-progress.text: Hail, $N.  How goes the rat catching?
416-progress.title: Rat Catching

418-progress.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-progress.text: I'm all ready to start cooking, do you have the ingredients for me?
418-progress.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

436-complete.name: Magmar Fellhew
436-complete.text:
Jern wants to know what the slowdown is, eh?

Ironband is putting together his latest progress report with details, but I can tell you this:

It's the Troggs!!
436-complete.title: Ironband's Excavation

6387-progress.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
6387-progress.text: Have you had your fill of Thelsamar so soon?  Are you ready to leave for another city?
6387-progress.title: Honor Students

6388-progress.name: Gryth Thurden
6388-progress.text: You look like you have somewhere to go.  Need one of my gryphons?
6388-progress.title: Gryth Thurden

6391-progress.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
6391-progress.text: What can I do for you, sir?
6391-progress.title: Ride to Ironforge

6392-progress.name: Brock Stoneseeker
6392-progress.text: Ah, $N.  Have you returned from Ironforge?
6392-progress.title: Return to Brock

86585-accept.name: Mountaineer Ylva
86585-accept.text:
The fallen mountaineer bears a standard of Ironforge. Perhaps she was scouting, or making a doomed charge. Either way, the standard has been cast down and trampled. The mountaineer was hit on the head so hard that her helm was knocked off and she was killed outright by a trogg, likely with a spiked club.

The trogg that killed her is probably still nearby, and likely remembers the banner. Raising the banner of Ironforge once more may call it out.
86585-accept.title: Banner of the Fallen

86585-complete.name: Captain Rugelfuss
86585-complete.text:
You found Ylva's body? Ah, the poor woman. She said she was going to show the troggs that Ironforge would never fall to their kind. She went looking for a few mountaineers who never returned from a patrol through trogg country. She was always too independent-minded to be cautious. Now we know what happened.

I'll take the banner back and make sure it's cleaned up and displayed. You should take her weapon. May it serve you well against the troggs.
86585-complete.title: Banner of the Fallen

86585-progress.name: Captain Rugelfuss
86585-progress.text: That banner looks like it's been in a war!
86585-progress.title: Banner of the Fallen

86758-accept.name: Marek Ironheart
86758-accept.text:
Did I ever tell you how I almost lost me hand to a crocolisk? Managed to jam me knife into its jaw, and scrambled out real quick. I thought I had the knife around here somewhere, but I can't seem to find it.

Anyway, that croc is probably still out there hunting along the edge of the lake. That nasty brute probably needs to go, for the safety of the other hunters, if nothing else.

I've taken to calling it Daggerfang. If you see it, give it a friendly hello from me! And by "hello" I mean "stab."
86758-accept.title: Twisting the Knife

86758-complete.name: Marek Ironheart
86758-complete.text:
Hah! You did it! I never thought that ol' croc would get its comeuppance, but that does the trick!

Oh ah... y'know, I had to get me another knife, but maybe that one will bring you some good luck. Why don't you hang onto it?
86758-complete.title: Twisting the Knife

86776-complete.name: Morhan Coppertongue
86776-complete.text: Ah, this is a relief! I should be able to keep the forge going now. Hopefully one of these days we'll get a trader bringing coal into town regularly!
86776-complete.title: Ingredients for the Forge

94449-complete.name: Bruegs Kindleborn
94449-complete.text: Hmm... that elder sent ye, eh? Well, a $c's word is solid, so I'll not argue. That means ye're ready for the next sapta. The sapta of fire. I see it in yer eyes already -- the burnin', the hunger. Ye've tasted power, and now ye want more. But mind yerself, $N. Remember what the stone taught ye. Fire's easy to wield, but harder to master. Know when to hold back.
94449-complete.title: Call of Fire

94465-accept.name: Bruegs Kindleborn
94465-accept.text:
Aye, ye've the strength to bear the totem o' fire, lad--but strength alone won't make ye ready.

Beyond the Valley o' Kings, in the crags of Loch Modan, lies a hidden path to one o' our sacred peaks. There, Braldir Ashmantle guards the Shrine o' the Dormant Flame. 

Take this torch to him--it shows yer intent. Return it burnin' by the shrine's brazier, and I'll see ye earn the totem proper.
94465-accept.title: Call of Fire

94465-complete.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94465-complete.text:
Ah, me apologies, $N. Didn't spot the Torch in yer hand. An honor to meet ye proper.

Many a wanderer climbs these heights chasin' tales of treasure or beasts, only to find naught but stone and silence. But we know better, don't we, $N?

This shrine holds truths far deeper than the Alliance can fathom. To us, it's a sacred flame that waits to be awakened.
94465-complete.title: Call of Fire

94465-progress.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94465-progress.text:
Greetin's, $N. Ye've made it to the Shrine o' the Dormant Flame, eh? Not many do. Only those well-versed in the $c's path can grasp the secrets this place holds. 

Shame ye came all this way just to be turned back--the climb's no stroll through Dun Morogh. But I'm the shrine's keeper, and I won't be lettin' just any foot trod about.
94465-progress.title: Call of Fire

94466-accept.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94466-accept.text:
Bah, ye didn't trek all this way for tales, did ye, $N? Ye seek the Eternal Flame and the fire totem.

First, ye'll need a sapta to bind yer spirit to the flame.

I'll craft it--but I'll need two things: fire tar from Tunnel Rat Geomancers in the kobold caves up north, and a reagent pouch from a Stonesplinter Seer lurkin' in the southern hills. Dangerous work, but worthy of the flame.
94466-accept.title: Call of Fire

94466-complete.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94466-complete.text:
These'll do fine, $N.

Fire ain't just fury and ruin--mark me words. It's life, it's forge, it's the breath o' creation. All things are bound in balance. One force tempers the other, gives it meaning. Without shadow, light's but a glare. Without flame, stone's but cold memory.

Masterin' magic means knowin' when to blend, not just burn. That's true wisdom, lad.
94466-complete.title: Call of Fire

94466-progress.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94466-progress.text: Aye, I've near all I need for the fire sapta, $N--just missin' the fire tar and the seer's pouch. The tar's carried by Tunnel Rat Geomancers in the kobold caves up north. The pouch ye'll need to wrest from a Stonesplinter seer in the southern hills. These ingredients are bound to flame, as all true saptas must be. Their elemental ties make our craft strong.
94466-progress.title: Call of Fire

94467-accept.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94467-accept.text:
The fire sapta's ready, $N. Now ye face the flame. Use it at the shrine, then climb to the peak. There, ye'll see the spirit--he'll not strike 'til ye do, but he'll know ye see him.

Strike fast, lad. The longer ye wait, the stronger he burns. When he falls, take his glowing embers and place 'em in the brazier. Light the torch and earn the fire's favor.
94467-accept.title: Call of Fire

94467-complete.name: Unknown
94467-complete.text:
A white hot flame ignites within the bowl as you place the ember within. You can feel the magical effects of the sapta coursing through your body and the fire dances rhythmically before you.

You place the top of the torch within the basin, and it immediately catches on fire. The smoke seems to drift towards the peak of the looming mountain.
94467-complete.title: Call of Fire

94467-progress.name: Unknown
94467-progress.text:
The brazier stands about a third your height, with charred inscriptions along its smooth metal rails. The metal shows no signs of wear from the weather, and the bowl seated at the top of it feels cool to the touch. 

Blackrock Mountain looms in the distance, in clear view to honor from this sacred place.
94467-progress.title: Call of Fire

94468-accept.name: Unknown
94468-accept.text:
Torch firmly in hand, you turn away from the brazier and look out over Loch Modan. You feel an excitement tugging at your spirit as the wind picks up and forces the flame to dance violently.

You start off down the path back to Dun Morogh in search of Bruegs Kindleborn.
94468-accept.title: Call of Fire

94468-complete.name: Bruegs Kindleborn
94468-complete.text:
By Madoran's beard, yer spirit burns brighter than any torch I've laid eyes on, $N--and that's somethin' to be proud of.

Keep walkin' this path, and the elements'll bend to yer will. Our kin will come to ye for wisdom and guidance. So let me be the first to offer me hearty congratulations--and present ye with yer newest totem. Ye've earned it, flameborn.
94468-complete.title: Call of Fire

94468-progress.name: Bruegs Kindleborn
94468-progress.text: Aye, $N? What do ye have there?
94468-progress.title: Call of Fire

95041-progress.name: Jemma Quikswitch
95041-progress.text: How is the data retrieval progressing?
95041-progress.title: Data Hoarders

96392-complete.name: Earthseer Farsen
96392-complete.text:
So ye see now, $c? Thick as cockroaches they are, and that's just the ones we can see from the sky.

Ye look like a sturdy enough sort. Hows about a bit o' violence?
96392-complete.title: Farsen's Watch

96395-accept.name: Unknown
96395-accept.text:
The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.

Please... help him... help him... rest...

Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
96395-accept.title: An Ancient Grudge

96395-complete.name: Unknown
96395-complete.text:
My... Thane... he... rests... yes... rest.

Thank... you...

I... rest...
96395-complete.title: An Ancient Grudge

96403-progress.name: Thom Filch
96403-progress.text: <Thom appears to absentmindedly rub his hands together as he looks at you.>
96403-progress.title: Important Heirlooms

971-accept.name: Gerrig Bonegrip
971-accept.text:
As you might know, I collect lore.  Old lore.  Powerful lore.  Lore that opens doorways, and lore that can awaken Those Who Sleep.

There are rumors of an old piece of lore, the Lorgalis Manuscript, at the bottom of Blackfathom Deeps in Ashenvale.  That place is the old dwelling of long-dead elves.  Elves who held great knowledge before their city fell to ruin.

Search Blackfathom Deeps for the manuscript.  Do this, and I will not forget it.  Not even after ... the end days.
971-accept.title: Knowledge in the Deeps

98326-progress.name: Gretta Ganter
